instructions: TypeScript pnpm monorepo for pythinker-code, a provider-agnostic AI coding agent. packages/* are published libraries; apps/* are the CLI/TUI, web UI, and dashboard. The root AGENTS.md is the authoritative contributor guide; nearest sub-directory AGENTS.md files add local rules.

rules.rule: Do not weaken types to silence errors: no `any`, unconstrained `unknown`, `@ts-ignore`, or type assertions added only to make a type error go away.

When a workspace package is added or removed in pnpm-workspace.yaml, flake.nix workspacePaths and workspaceNames must be updated in the same PR. A missing path silently drops files from the Nix build.
Tests must be able to fail. Flag vacuous assertions: empty-set matches, missing awaits on async expectations, and mocked units asserting on the mock itself.
Solid signals must not be destructured, rendering must stay allocation-light, and no blocking I/O on the render path.
PRs that change published package behavior need a changeset. Default to minor or patch; a major bump requires explicit maintainer confirmation.
